Forecast census from a hubverse admission forecast

Source: R/fcast_census.R
fcast_census.Rd

Forecast census from a hubverse admission forecast

Usage

fcast_census(forecast, los, history)

Arguments

forecast

Hubverse model-output tibble (from hubData::collect_hub()).

los

Numeric survival vector P(LOS > d), e.g. from los_spec().

history

Hubverse target time-series tibble (from hubData::connect_target_timeseries() then collected) — used as burn-in admissions before each forecast.

Value

Same hubverse columns as forecast, with value now census.
